title: Free Look, Cancellation Fees and Refund Bases, Pass and Trip Protection
content:
Three figures govern what a Pass and Trip Protection plan carries when the household gives it up: the free
look period counted in calendar days from the day the plan was taken, the cancellation fee the plan holds, and
the basis on which the plan returns premium.

| Plan | Free look period (calendar days) | Cancellation fee (USD) | Refund basis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | 10 | 15.00 | No refund |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | 14 | 25.00 | Pro rata by days |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | 14 | 35.00 | Pro rata by days |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | 14 | 25.00 | No refund |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | 21 | 45.00 | Pro rata by days |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | 30 | 95.00 | Pro rata by days |

**On the free look period.** The shortest is the 10 calendar days of Season Pass Protection Basic and the
longest the 30 calendar days of the Collective Total Protection Concierge plan; Season Pass Protection Plus,
Season Pass Protection Premier and Collective Trip Protection Standard each carry 14 days, and Collective Trip
Protection Elite 21.

**On the refund basis.** Four of the six plans return premium on a pro rata basis by days — Season Pass
Protection Plus, Season Pass Protection Premier, Collective Trip Protection Elite and the Collective Total
Protection Concierge plan. Season Pass Protection Basic and Collective Trip Protection Standard return
premium on no refund basis.

**On the cancellation fee.** It rises with the plan, from 15.00 USD on Season Pass Protection Basic through
25.00 USD on Season Pass Protection Plus and Collective Trip Protection Standard, 35.00 USD on Season Pass
Protection Premier and 45.00 USD on Collective Trip Protection Elite, to 95.00 USD on the Collective Total
Protection Concierge plan.
